design.watchdogStatus: automation/lib/watchdog-status.mjs + scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs: every daemon heartbeat (and every single tick) writes .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json atomically (writeJsonAtomic) with the Founder's fields and an overall health derived only from real signals (HEALTHY, WAITING_PROVIDER, FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED, STOPPED, UNHEALTHY; an unknown or stale heartbeat or a broken transition log is never healthy); discovery runs through new read-only contracts git.listBranchHeads, git.worktreeList and ps.scheduledTaskInfo (a fixed, locale-independent Get-ScheduledTask query limited to the two policy task names) plus git.revParse, the verified transition log and the provider state; it refreshes every 5 minutes and after each tick, a failed probe is reported UNAVAILABLE; a write failure is logged and never blocks execution; --status returns the artifact and --self-check verifies it is fresh and written by the live daemon.
design.wakeBaseline: a wake request written while a tick runs or while the heartbeat and status are written is not lost: runDaemon records the wake-file time when the tick starts and the sleeper uses it as its baseline (found when the status write widened the window between the WAITING heartbeat and the sleep; scenario A timed out before the fix).
design.selfUpgrade: automation/lib/control-plane-upgrade.mjs + scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs + scripts/uasco-supervisor-launcher.mjs + scripts/register-orchestrator-autostart.ps1: the task starts the launcher through the junction control\current; planControlPlaneUpgrade decides (enabled, no Global Stop, known commits, master is a governed merge recorded as CLOSED with mergedCommit, master descends from the running plane, nothing in flight, a protected file of the running plane's sealed manifest changed); performControlPlaneUpgrade prepares control\<commit12> only through git.cloneLocal/git.fetchOrigin, git.checkoutDetached, the new read-only git.headCommit, git.status, node.script ensure-dependencies (node_modules copied offline from the running plane when the reviewed lock is identical) and node.script verify-trust-root, then switches the junction (old link removed as a link only, previous plane kept) and writes control\CURRENT.json; the CLI records a CONTROL_PLANE_UPGRADED transition and exits 4 (daemon start and after each merging tick, and after a single tick); the launcher treats 4 as a clean stop so the next trigger starts the new plane; the watchdog status reports the current control plane.

rules: The Claude routine executes zero shell, PowerShell, cmd or Bash commands, never calls git or schtasks, never mutates repository or orchestration state, performs no reviews, starts no Claude/Codex workers, repairs nothing and is not required for UASCO execution.

The repository-native UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor is the only executor: Windows Task Scheduler -> UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor -> durable repo state -> Claude CLI builder -> validation -> Codex CLI reviewer -> remediation/merge -> release/signing/Phase0.

The local supervisor maintains a passive status artifact .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json atomically with: supervisor status, heartbeat, current master, active package, implementation queue count, review queue count, blocked lanes, Codex quota/retry status, signer status, Phase0 status, last successful action, next scheduled action, current Founder decisions and overall health.
The supervisor performs all state discovery the routine used to perform (git refs, worktrees, scheduler status, transition log, provider retry state) and persists it into WATCHDOG_STATUS.json.

The routine may only read that artifact and summarize it; if reading it would need an interactive permission it takes no action. Command-executing behaviour in the routine is disabled and must not be approved again.

findings.summary: builderRound adopted a committed round only through a round marker. The marker was written non-atomically after the commit, and prepareClone reset the implementation clone to the base before the marker was read. A crash between the commit and a complete marker, or a torn marker, caused a second builder call and commit.
findings.fix: The committed round is now recognised from git before the clone is reset. A clean implementation-clone HEAD is adopted only if its single parent is exactly the base, its committer is the orchestrator identity and its subject is the exact round subject. If there is no clone or its HEAD is the base, the package branch tip is checked in the same way. The check uses a new read-only contract, git.commitIdentity (git log -1 --no-show-signature --format=%P/%cn <%ce>/%s), under the repo or control root. The adopted commit is checked out directly. An unrecognised clean HEAD is kept as evidence (.unrecognized-*) and is not adopted. git.commitAll pins the committer identity (ORCHESTRATOR_GIT_IDENTITY) through GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL. The round marker records the start time only and is written atomically (tmp + rename).

findings.summary: switchJunction removed control\current, the only launch path of the scheduled task, before renaming current.next. There was no rollback and no bootstrap outside the link, so an interruption left the supervisor unlaunchable until it was repaired manually.
findings.fix: Windows cannot rename a link over an existing link, so the switch is made recoverable. It stages current.next, writes the journal control\SWITCH.json atomically, moves the old link to current.prev, renames current.next to current, and rolls back in place if that rename fails. The record is written last and the journal is then removed. recoverControlPlaneLink is self-contained and is embedded verbatim in a stable entry, control\uasco-supervisor-entry.mjs, which installControlPlaneEntry writes atomically. The scheduled task now runs that entry with the control directory as working directory. On every start the entry restores the plane that was running before an interrupted switch (current.prev, the journal's previous target or CURRENT.json), or the staged plane if there was no previous one. It finalizes the record when the link has already moved, never deletes a real directory, never invents a link, and then loads the launcher through control\current. register-orchestrator-autostart.ps1 installs the entry from the verified plane and checks that the launcher is reachable through the link. checkAndUpgrade runs the same recovery as defense in depth.

findings.summary: checkAndUpgrade planned with a Global Stop snapshot, and performControlPlaneUpgrade switched the link after the final command without a live stop check.
findings.fix: performControlPlaneUpgrade now requires a live shouldStop predicate and refuses to run without one. It evaluates the predicate after verify-trust-root and before the first filesystem change (entry, journal, link, record). A throwing predicate counts as stopped. While Global Stop is active it returns DEFERRED and changes nothing. checkAndUpgrade passes the predicate through, and uasco-orchestrator.mjs passes stopNow (the live GLOBAL_STOP.json check).

findings.summary: A failed installed-autostart registration was recorded on a terminal PHASE0_DONE release and never retried.
findings.fix: The registration is now its own lane on the release (release.autostart, mirrored to phase0.installedAutostart); the release stays PHASE0_DONE, so the acceptance and its dependents are kept. A failed or unknown result becomes RETRY_PENDING with a 5/10/20... minute backoff. nextAction dispatches the new AUTOSTART action when it is due, and the daemon wake planning includes AUTOSTART_RETRY. The new autostart executor runs only ps.registerInstalledAutostart for the accepted installation bound to that release (marker zipSha256), so it never extracts, reinstalls or moves anything and never touches the construction-supervisor task. After policy phase0.maxAutostartRegistrationAttempts (5) attempts the lane becomes REGISTRATION_BLOCKED_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED and is not retried. A release that is not the accepted installation becomes REGISTRATION_BLOCKED. An executor error counts as one attempt and never sends the release to a Founder decision.
